added.member: TSX element props: name, spotlight, anchor
added.summary: `name` gives an element a name to find it by. `anchor` now also takes a name: the element then stands on that UI element's box (its top left, plus `lift`'s x and y as fractions of the box's size, so `lift={[0, 1, 0]}` sits under it) and follows it every frame. `spotlight="<name>"` makes an element a tutorial's shade: its `bg-*` colour covers the screen outside the named element's box, and it takes every press there, so the lit element keeps its own presses.
